description: This file defines the DataGroupAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for managing data groups within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve all data group permissions, but other operations like create or delete are not implemented.

classes.name: DataGroupAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing Data Groups in OrangeHRM, providing functionality to retrieve data group permissions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of data group permissions related to the current user role.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method, currently an empty rule set.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method intended for creating new data groups; currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create method; not implemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method intended for deleting data groups; currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete method; not implemented.
